observations.text: CLASSYS sells HIFU, monopolar RF, microneedle RF, laser and related aesthetic devices with recurring consumables tied to installed equipment across 80+ countries.
FY2025 consolidated revenue KRW336.820B, operating profit KRW170.601B, net income KRW131.970B, OCF KRW163.936B.
H1 2026 revenue KRW192.691B, operating profit KRW81.140B, net income KRW58.677B; Q2 revenue KRW105.515B and operating profit KRW43.941B.
H1 overseas revenue KRW146.629B, about 76% of sales. June global installed base was about 48,000 units; ex-South-America exports grew 29% in H1 and overseas consumables 32.6% YoY in Q2.
Q2 domestic device/consumables sales fell materially YoY while overseas sales remained strong; 2026 revenue guidance was revised from KRW470-510B to KRW430-460B.
CLASSYS acquired 77.5% of JL Health/Medsystems in Brazil and 100% of related Argentina/Colombia entities on 2026-03-05, moving key Latin-American markets toward direct sales.
At acquisition JL Health included about KRW48.8B receivables, KRW23.0B inventory and KRW96.0B borrowings; preliminary JL Health goodwill was about KRW19.9B.
H1 consolidated OCF fell to KRW15.47B from KRW53.26B despite KRW58.68B net income, with KRW43.79B working-capital outflow. Parent-only OCF was KRW38.66B.
Trade/other receivables and impairment allowance rose sharply after Brazil consolidation; gross receivables/other were about KRW171.98B and allowance KRW62.31B versus year-end KRW83.21B and KRW1.74B.
June consolidated cash was KRW78.70B and bank debt about KRW146.66B; financial products/investments add liquidity and most bank debt is short term.
270,000 treasury shares were cancelled in H1 2026 and KRW65.15B dividends paid. January option exercise used 66,287 treasury shares rather than new issuance.
Yoon Joon-oh became CEO in July and Taek-soo Kim CTO in August 2026, targeting AI/software/data integration with the EBD platform.
FDA 510(k) K253504 for Volnewmer received a Substantially Equivalent decision on 2026-07-13.
The moat is the combined installed base, consumable recurrence, KOL/clinical network, approvals, broad modalities and increasingly direct distribution rather than one patent.
Direct Brazil distribution may internalize margin/customer data but also imports financing/receivable risk and working-capital intensity absent from the historical manufacturer model.
Normalized owner cash KRW120-145B, central KRW135B, using TTM NI + D&A - capex and treating the H1 working-capital shock as partly integration-related.
At the current price the bottleneck is post-acquisition cash conversion/credit loss evidence, not valuation.
